title: Tongue of Madness
summary: Alchemy ingredient for Tadpole Elixir and a quest component for Omeluum.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Tongues of Madness into Sublimate of Tongue of Madness, then add any Essence to make Tadpole Elixir.
fields.Quest use: Give 1 Tongue and 1 Timmask Spore to Omeluum for his parasite investigation.
fields.Acquisition: Arcane Tower greenhouse and basement, or eligible alchemy traders.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
